emergencyModal.title: 24/7 EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE
emergencyModal.subtitle: If you suspect financial fraud or your card was swallowed, stay calm and follow these steps immediately:
emergencyModal.step1Desc: Open your mobile banking app to temporarily lock your card, or call the 24/7 bank hotline listed below.
emergencyModal.step2Title: 2. Official 24/7 Bank Emergency Hotlines (Click to Call)
emergencyModal.helperNoteTitle: Show this Vietnamese message to local people for immediate assistance:
emergencyModal.helperNote: Tôi là du khách nước ngoài. Tôi nghi ngờ tài khoản ngân hàng của tôi đang bị lừa đảo hoặc cây ATM bị lỗi nuốt thẻ. Xin vui lòng giúp tôi gọi điện cho ngân hàng hoặc cảnh sát 113.

atmFlowModal.title: Safe ATM / CRM Machine Operation Flow
atmFlowModal.stepWithdraw1: Step 1: Inspect the card slot and area. Gently wiggle the card slot. If it feels loose or has glue residue, DO NOT USE IT.
atmFlowModal.stepWithdraw2: Step 2: Insert your card facing chip-up in the direction of the arrow.
atmFlowModal.stepWithdraw3: Step 3: Select language (English). Cover the keypad with your free hand while typing your 6-digit PIN.
atmFlowModal.stepWithdraw4: Step 4: Select Cash Withdrawal and enter your amount (typical limit is 2,000,000 - 5,000,000 VND per withdrawal).
atmFlowModal.stepWithdraw5: Step 5: VERY IMPORTANT: The machine returns your card BEFORE dispensing cash. Retrieve and secure your card first, then collect cash.
atmFlowModal.stepDeposit1: Step 1: Select Cash Deposit on screen. Insert chip-enabled ID card or bank card into the slot.
atmFlowModal.stepDeposit2: Step 2: Straighten and flatten your banknotes. Ensure no torn edges, sticky tape, or metal clips.
atmFlowModal.stepDeposit3: Step 3: Place cash stack into the automated deposit tray (max 100-200 notes). Confirm total on screen.
